title: The Game Manual
intro: How to set up and play JOURNEYWAYS, solo or in a group: the loose rules, the shape of a turn, and what each of the five card colours means. One copy is included with the game.
pages_hint: Thirteen pages. Pick any page to read it up close.

download.note: PDF, about 2.2 MB. Same manual in English, Spanish, or French.
